title: heterotheca pumila
intro: Heterotheca pumila, commonly known as False Heal-All, is a perennial herb native to North America, belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Heterotheca pumila are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca pumila include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
